lines.text: Jeremiah says he was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter and did not know about the plot against him.
The people of Anathoth were seeking Jeremiah's life and told him not to prophesy in the name of the LORD.
The LORD of Hosts says the young men of Anathoth will die by famine and their sons and daughters by the sword.

wrong_details.wrong: die by famine and their sons and daughters by the sword
wrong_details.true: die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine

lines.text: Jeremiah says the LORD planted the wicked, who honor Him with their lips, and he asks that they be dragged away like sheep.
The LORD asks how Jeremiah will compete with camels, and says even his own father's household has betrayed him.
